x.paused_reason: owner_decision_2026-08-29: "im not funding X so find a $0 workaround or kill it." X's API is pay-per-use with no free tier -- every write this repository has ever made answered HTTP 402 problems/credits-depleted, starting with the very first request, and nothing has ever posted. At roughly $0.20 per post with a URL, eight a day is about $48/month. The owner has decided not to pay it. This is NOT a dormant pause: X is off for API POSTING only, and distribution continues through the delivery route below. That is what pause_mode "delivery_route" means and why it is not "dormant" like LinkedIn. It used to mean a sheet the owner worked through herself; that was retired on 2026-08-29 when she said "this means i manually have to do it? i will never do it honestly", and Buffer replaced it entirely. Nothing in this repository asks her to do anything now.

x.meaning_of_buffer_queued: Buffer accepted the post and holds it in the X channel's queue. It is NOT published yet: Buffer sends it at the channel's next posting slot. The entry keeps status 'buffer_queued' with the Buffer post id and is never re-sent.
x.meaning_of_deferred: Buffer's free plan caps how many posts may sit queued at once. When that cap is reached the remaining entries are simply left alone: they keep 'queued_for_auto_post' and the next run offers them again as Buffer drains its queue. Nothing is dropped, nothing is parked in another file, and nothing is asked of anybody.

hand_post_history.note: Historical only: what the owner posted to X by hand before Buffer carried it. Read on every run so those posts are never sent again. Nothing updates it and nothing asks her to.
